questions: Are the facial movements shown involuntary and recurring episodes rather than deliberate expressions?
Were you fully conscious and able to remember what happened throughout the episode?
Did the episode begin suddenly, without your being able to control or stop it?
Have these episodes been happening repeatedly for more than a day?
Do the movements affect both sides of your face equally?
Do they ever spread to your neck, tongue, jaw, arms, or legs?
Do you have any weakness, numbness, facial drooping, difficulty speaking, or trouble seeing?
Have you had difficulty breathing, swallowing, or opening your mouth?
Have you had a fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, or a recent wound?
Did the movements start after taking or changing a medication, including an antipsychotic, nausea medication, antidepressant, or stimulant?
Have you recently received Botox, facial injections, dental treatment, or another procedure involving your face?
Can you temporarily suppress the movements or stop them by relaxing, touching your face, or changing your activity?
